节拍 = 可用时间 ÷ 需求。按节拍投料，线上不堆料，交期也短。下一课找这条线上: Takt time = available time ÷ demand. Releasing parts at takt time prevents WIP buildup and keeps lead times short. In the next lesson, find the slowest operation on this line.
先算出**节拍**（客户要求每隔多少秒出一件），再把**投料间隔**改成节拍。\:
First calculate the **takt time** (how many seconds between finished parts are needed to meet customer demand), then set the **release interval** to match it.
**What success looks like**: In "Goals & Answers", both hourly throughput ≥ 58 and average production lead time ≤ 5 min show ✓, and your answer to the takt time question is correct.
投得比节拍快，料只会堆在线上；按节拍投，线上不堆料，交期最短。: Releasing parts faster than takt time only builds up WIP. Releasing at takt time prevents buildup and minimizes lead time.
两班，每班 8 小时、休息 30 分钟：可用时间 = 2 × 7.5 × 360: Two shifts, 8 hours each, with a 30-minute break: available time = 2 × 7.5 × 3600 = **54,000 s**. The customer needs 900 pcs per day. Enter the cycle time in "Targets & Answers" (numbers only, in seconds).
节拍 = 可用生产时间 ÷ 需求数量。: Cycle time = available production time ÷ demand.
按现在的投料跑半小时: Run for half an hour with the current feed rate
点「**运行**」，等仿真时钟走过 30 分钟。点一下**线边库 B0**，看里: Click "**Run**" and wait for the simulation clock to advance by 30 minutes. Click **Line-Side Buffer B0** and check whether the number of parts is increasing.
现在平均 40 秒投一件，比三道工序都快，多出来的件只能排队。: The current feed rate is one part every 40 seconds, faster than all three operations, so the excess parts have to queue.
倍速调到 60× 会快很多。: Set the speed to 60× to run much faster.
把投料间隔改成节拍: Set the feed interval to the cycle time
点「带我去」选中**投料 SRC**，在右边属性「节拍」里把**到达间隔**从: Click "Take Me To" and select **Feed SRC**. In the "Cycle Time" properties on the right, change **Interarrival Time** from `expo(40)` to the cycle time in seconds (enter a number only, for example, `75`).
写固定的数字，每件间隔一样；写 expo(…) 是随机的，忽快忽慢更容易堆料。: A fixed number gives the same interval for every part; `expo(…)` makes the interval random, with parts arriving at varying speeds and making it easier for material to pile up.
属性面板在工作台右边；参数按分组折叠，展开「节拍」那一组。: The Properties panel is on the right side of the Workbench. Properties are grouped and collapsed; expand the "Cycle Time" group.
重置后再跑，看目标变成 ✓: Reset and run again to see the target turn into ✓
先点「**重置**」（清掉前面堆的料；弹出提示时选「**保留并保存**」，留住你: First click "**Reset**" (this clears the accumulated material; when prompted, choose "**Keep and Save**" to retain your changed feed interval), then click "**Run**". You're done when both "Hourly Output" and "Average Production Cycle" under "Targets & Answers" show ✓.
前面堆在线边库的料要好一阵才能消化完，重置以后从头跑，数字马上就对了。: It takes a while to work through the material already piled up in the line-side buffer. Reset and run from the beginning, and the numbers will be correct right away.
间隔比 55 秒小，焊接 M2 来不及做，又会堆料；比 62 秒大，一小时就不够: If the interval is under 55 s, M2 can't keep up with welding, so material piles up again. If it's over 62 s, you won't reach 58 pcs in an hour.
点任务面板上绿色的「**提交评分**」。: Click the green "**Submit for Grading**" button in the task panel.
